youtube.title: Holidays Feel Heavy? Christmas Morning Prayer | Luke 2:10-11 KJV
youtube.text:
Good morning. Holidays feel heavy this year? Hear what the angel said.

"And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people. For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord." Luke 2:10-11 (KJV)

The first Christmas news started with fear not. It still does.

Have a blessed day. Type amen, and send this to somebody starting their day.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.
